prompt: Plan A costs $\$20$ plus $\$5$ per month. Plan B costs $\$10$ plus $\$7$ per month. After how many months do they cost the same?
explanation: $m = 5$. Check: both plans cost $\$45$ at 5 months. ✓

alternativeExplanations.title: Build a table
steps: Month 1: A = 25, B = 17. Month 3: A = 35, B = 31. B is catching up by $2 each month.
A starts $10 ahead and B gains $2 per month: 10 ÷ 2 = 5 months to tie.

alternativeExplanations.title: As two racers
steps: Plan A starts 10 dollars ahead but walks 5 per month; B runs 7 per month.
B closes the 10-dollar gap at 2 per month → catches A after 5 months.
